reviews.title: Account disabled after completing first 15$ worth of surveys
reviews.text:
I went to redeem my first 15$ worth of rewards after endless hours of surveys, and was given this message after about 2 days of waiting for the reward: “Your account has been suspended. Please provide additional information to confirm and reactivate your account” After requesting further information via a web form, I was prompted with something like “a response will be issued within 30 days.” Absolutely dissatisfied with the absurd amount of time I put into this app in order to receive a meager 15$ only to have that followed up with a suspension.  I am very unlikely to continue using this app in the future. 

I do not think this platform is worth any amount of time compared to the other options out there. Filling out surveys is extremely time consuming and will net lower compensation than panhandling. Many other apps/sites have higher compensation (although only slightly better than begging in the streets) with less troubles. I do not recommend swagbucks

reviews.title: Fraud Alert!
reviews.text:
I would give no stars if I could. I have a major missing money issue with Swagbucks and Prodege, the parent company, has refused to help even with proof of game tracking via email. This is a nightmare and I hope no one else goes through this. I played Slot Mate, completed tasks and purchased coin packages of over $300. I had $275 worth
of Swagbucks in my account and after pending for a few days, they just vanished and then it looks like I didn't even play the game at all. Then I go to file a complaint with customer service and I need to verify my email, but the link I'm sent takes me to a page that doesn't work. So after messaging the help desk a couple of times and getting the same response that they can't help me through email even though I explain I'm having an issue on the app, I file a complaint with Prodege on the BBB website. I wait for a response for about 10 days and get a generic message to contact customer service. At this point I’ve already explained the issue with verifying my email and the broken link I’m sent multiple times, but I explain the situation again and  submit my proof. Then another 10 or so days later, I get a response that Prodege won't help because there's no tracking on the Swagbucks website. So why is there no tracking on their end, but I have all the emails? Well I think that someone cleared the tracking from my account and removed the pending rewards so I couldn't get paid. Let’s say it’s a glitch though, I have proof of completed tasks and Pro

reviews.title: THIS APP IS B.S.
reviews.text:
I used to REALLY REALLY look forward to participating in the trivia, games, surveys, etc. this app has to offer… since i absolutely love trivia & it was a fun & great way to unwind after a long days work. until NOW. I attempted to login & i couldn’t! My account had been suspended due to unscrupulous behavior & conduct! I have no idea what this means or what they are talking about! I am very very very offended! I only logged on to participate in the nightly trivia & play/download games. I never made offensive comments in the trivia chats (but I have seen quite a few questionable comments night after night from the same individuals, but they were obviously not reprimanded). I replied to the ruling of my account being suspended, and pleaded my case… maybe my account was hacked??? I don’t understand why this ruling was made… I am NOT a criminal! But the ruling was upheld 😡

I had been a subscriber to SwagBucks for quite a while, and to have these venomous accusations hurled upon me was nothing short of mean, hurtful & baseless. I was never presented a valid reason, shown proof of what my wrong doing was.

If I could give this app a negative Star ⭐️ I would. Customer service is horrible 😣

reviews.title: App crashes randomly
reviews.text:
The app works for the most part, but when it crashes, it’s in the middle of a survey I have spent a significant amount of time on and I had to pause for a few minutes. It kicks me out and I’ve lost all of the progress I’ve made and I can’t go back. I would add that the controls can be confusing for the app versus a survey. Sometimes I think I’m going back to recheck a question on the survey and instead it brings me back to the available surveys to take. Which makes me realize I used the wrong button. Then it also closes out the survey I was working on. There’s no way to get back in. So pay attention. I prefer the desktop experience to the app, but I also appreciate the mobile option since it’s portable.

Be warned before investing a significant amount of time with this. I was saving up for a $50 gift card and when I reached 49,000 points and I had an automated add from a previous survey, it literally wiped out those 49,000 points. I will never again use this app. Huge waste of time. When I emailed tech support, I received no response.
